name: KIRA KIRA☆PRETTY CURE A LA MODE
description: Ichika Usami is a second year middle school student whose family runs the Kirakira Patisserie shop. One day, she encounters a fairy named Pekorin and learns that evil monsters known as Henteko have been stealing "Kirakiraru", the energy that resides within sweets and desserts. Thus, Ichika becomes a Pretty Cure and, alongside four other cures, forms the Kirakira PreCure a la Mode to fight off the Henteko and protect the sweets.

videos.title: Full of Love! Cure Whip, Ready to Serve!
videos.overview: When Usami Ichika tries to bake a cake for her mother, she's visited by a helpful fairy and a troublemaking monster! To save her cake, she must transform into the legendary pâtissier, Cure Whip!

videos.title: The Little Genius, Cure Custard!
videos.overview: Ichika bonds with shy Arisugawa Himari over a mutual love of purin. Though Arisugawa fears her passion for sweets might scare her new friend away, it comes in handy when she transforms into Cure Custard!

videos.title: Roar, Lion! Cure Gelato!
videos.overview: Ichika and Himari are head-over-heels for the hardcore rocker, Tategami Aoi. But when a monster tries to interrupt her concert, Aoi transforms into the electric Cure Gelato!

videos.title: Three Girls United! Let's La Mix-It-Up!
videos.overview: The three new best friends decide to bake an extra-special treat for their favorite ballerina. But is the recipe for cream puffs biting off more than they can chew?!

videos.title: That Capricious Young Lady Is Cure Macaron!
videos.overview: Kotozume Yukari is the most beautiful girl in her school, exceptionally talented... and bored with everything. But when she finds herself taking a liking to Ichika, she winds up as her newest ally, Cure Macaron!

videos.title: Is This Love?! The Glorious Cure Chocolat!
videos.overview: When kind and dreamy Kenjo Akira moves in next door, Ichika starts to feel things she's never felt before... but after making chocolate together, she's shocked to see her new crush transform into Cure Chocolat!

videos.title: Pekorin Makes Donuts, Peko!
videos.overview: Reminiscing about her missing fairy friends has Pekorin feeling blue. To cheer her up, Ichika proposes a donut party on the mountain!

videos.title: The KiraPâti's Opening... Isn't Happening!
videos.overview: Ichika wants her friends to open their own pâtisserie! But as they assign roles and get to work, nothing seems to go right...

videos.title: The KiraPâti Will Make Your Love Come True!
videos.overview: The KiraPâti is open for business... but nobody's coming! Will baking cookies for a lovelorn young man help to turn their luck around?

videos.title: Yukari vs. Akira! A Tempestuous Errand!
videos.overview: Akira and Yukari are the stars of the KiraPâti, but when Ichika sends them out to buy toppings for the perfect fruit tart, their natural differences assert themselves.

videos.title: Showdown! Precure vs. the Gummy Gang!
videos.overview: The KiraPâti has a booth in the town's sweets festival! But Gummy and his gang are back, and they're hungry... for the town's entire supply of kirakiral!

videos.title: The Enemy Is... the Popular Exchange Student?!
videos.overview: A cool and mysterious transfer student, Kuroki Rio, arrives at Ichika's school. Meanwhile, a new threat arrives to challenge the Precures: the sinister masked Julio!

videos.title: Can't Do It! Himari's Unexpected Debut!
videos.overview: The local greengrocer thinks Himari is the perfect person to do PR for Ichigozaka Shopping Street! But will her fear of sharing her passion hold her back from it?

videos.title: Rich Girl Rock 'n' Roll!
videos.overview: Aoi is snatched away in the middle of a concert... by her family butler?! Rock 'n' roll is Aoi's only outlet from her restrictive upbringing, and if Ichika can't help, she might lose it forever!

videos.title: For the Sake of Love! The Angry Cure Chocolat!
videos.overview: Akira's sister Miku gets a reprieve from the hospital to visit the KiraPâti! While Akira frets about Miku's health, Miku seems desperate to find a way to show her appreciation for Akira.

videos.title: A Dangerously Sudden Approach! Yukari and Rio!
videos.overview: Yukari invites the girls to a tea ceremony at her traditional home... and sets a trap for Julio!

videos.title: The Final Experiment! Cure Whip Can't Transform!
videos.overview: Julio sets his manipulative sights on the leader of the Precures: Cure Whip! Can Ichika's love for her mother win the day?!

videos.title: The Source of the Rumors Is the Powerful Bibli!
videos.overview: While the Precure girls struggle with a nasty rumor about their shop, Master Noir sends a new envoy to rustle up kirakiral in Ichigozaka: the cynical trickster Bibli!

videos.title: The Pâtissier Prodigy! Kirahoshi Ciel!
videos.overview: Parisian sweets prodigy Kirahoshi Ciel arrives in Ichigozaka, and Ichika is determined to become her disciple!

videos.title: Admiration Mix-It-Up! Ichika and Ciel!
videos.overview: Ciel decides to give Ichika a lesson in fine ingredients with a trip through the mountains. But a sweet visit to a honey farm is interrupted by a Bibli attack!

videos.title: Say What?! Ciel's Identity Revealed!
videos.overview: The fairies have returned to Mt. Ichigo! Ichika and the others head there to celebrate, but... wait, why is Ciel there, too?!

videos.title: Stop It, Julio! The Kirakiral of Hatred!
videos.overview: When Julio returns to vent his hatred on the Precures, Ciel reveals the secret connection they share.

videos.title: Fly! The Rainbow Pegasus, Cure Parfait!
videos.overview: When Ciel tries desperately to make amends with Julio, she's carried off by Noir... and a new Precure is born!

videos.title: The Transfer Student Is the Fairy Kirarin?!
videos.overview: Ciel transfers to the girls' school to strengthen their bonds as a team. But the brutish Glaive rolls up in Ichigozaka to steal kirakiral en masse!

videos.title: A Whirlwind Marriage?! Princess Yukari!
videos.overview: A visiting prince decides to make Yukari his bride, and Yukari seems to entertain the possibility. Akira's objections just end up with her wrapped in the affair... as a rival for Yukari's affections!

videos.title: Summer! The Beach! The KiraPâti Gets Stranded!
videos.overview: An innocent trip to the beach ends up with the KiraPâti girls stranded on a deserted island! In their quest to find enough kirakiral to get home, they run into an old rival who's just as stuck as they are.

videos.title: The Hot Live Battle! Aoi vs. Misaki!
videos.overview: Aoi gets her dream: to appear in a rock festival with her idol, Misaki! But can Aoi sing her heart out when the two are pitted against each other?

videos.title: Rise! Himari's Big Sweets Experiment!
videos.overview: A mysterious professor whisks Himari away to be his assistant in creating history's biggest sponge cake. Will she rise to the challenge, or will her on-stage debut be a flop?!

videos.title: Emergency! Cure Macaron, Stained in Darkness!
videos.overview: Yukari finds herself feeling pensive over her own capricious personality, and the sinister new foe, Elysio, offers her a window into her soul.

videos.title: The Targeted School Festival! Chocolat in Wonderland!
videos.overview: When Miku joins the KiraPâti girls at the cultural festival at Yukari and Akira's school, Elysio offers Akira a terrible ultimatum.

videos.title: Hold Back the Tears! The Reason for Ichika's Smile!
videos.overview: Ichika struggles to be her usual cheerful self when her mother returns home unexpectedly.

videos.title: Kirakira Sparkle, Six Unique Traits! Kirakiral Creamer!
videos.overview: The girls are sent a hundred years into Ichigozaka's past, where they witness the extent of Noir's evil... and meet the Precure of old!

videos.title: Sweets Are Dangerous?! The Animal of Darkness Reawakens!!
videos.overview: Noir's most loyal servant, Diable, is sowing discord among the citizens of Ichigozaka... and he's using sweets to do it?!

videos.title: A Little Grudge Match! Cat Yukari vs. Fairy Kirarin!
videos.overview: In circumstances as capricious as she is, Yukari is turned into a cat! Soon, she finds herself caught up in a turf war between the feral cats and fairies of Mt. Ichigozaka!

videos.title: Complementary Tastes! Himari and Aoi!
videos.overview: Awkward Himari finds herself questioning her friendship with Aoi while attending a high-society party. But soon, all of the guests are at each other's throats!

videos.title: Ichika and Akira! The Great Ichigozaka Games!
videos.overview: The annual Ichigozaka Games bring out the competitive spirit in everyone, but the athletic Akira is particularly determined to make a good showing for her neighborhood.

videos.title: Salut! Ciel's Going Back to France?!
videos.overview: Ciel's sponsor has come all the way from Paris to demand that she return! Can the girls convince the demanding Madame Selene of Ichigozaka's quiet appeal?

videos.title: Pekorin's a Person, Peko!
videos.overview: Pekorin wakes up one night... to find out she's turned into a human?! Proud to finally get to do things she could never do before, she heads out on her first real errand.

videos.title: Aw, No! Precure's Enemy Is Ichigozaka?!
videos.overview: While the girls try to convince the other fairy tribes to join their fight against Noir, Glaive returns... with his nastiest trick yet!

videos.title: Let's la Costume-Change! Sweets Castle, Ready to Serve!
videos.overview: The Precures' efforts to save the citizens of Ichigozaka continue to fail in the face of Glaive's darkness. What can possibly save them?!

videos.title: Dreams Are Kira-Pika Infinite!
videos.overview: A mysterious kirakiral thief terrorizing Ichigozaka turns out to be Elysio's latest plan to tear Ciel's family apart.

videos.title: Sing It Out, Wow! Aoi's Last Song!
videos.overview: Aoi struggles to figure out what to do when Wild Azur's leader and lyricist reveals that he has to quit the band.

videos.title: The Secret Ingredient Is Courage! Himari's Recipe for the Future!
videos.overview: Himari decides to test how much she's changed in the past year by auditioning for a cooking show.

videos.title: Feelings Hidden in the Snow! Shout Out Your Love, Akira!
videos.overview: When Miku goes missing from the hospital, Akira is driven to desperation searching for her.

videos.title: Farewell, Yukari! The Thrilling Sweets Christmas!
videos.overview: Yukari makes a rare suggestion: the KiraPâti should host a Christmas party! But an announcement about her future threatens to bring down the merry mood...

videos.title: The Big Battle with Noir! A Birthday Without Smiles!
videos.overview: With life about to take them in separate directions, the girls decide to hold a birthday party for Ichika.

videos.title: Return the Love! Cure Pekorin, Ready to Serve!
videos.overview: Elysio's desire for perfect control locks the Precures in a world without love or hate. The only one who can save them is... Pekorin?!

videos.title: The Final Battle! The Whole World, Let's la Mix-It-Up!
videos.overview: The Precures make one last desperate stand to convince Elysio of the importance of love.

videos.title: Go Where Love Takes You! Whip, Step, Jump!
videos.overview: Before they go their separate ways, the KiraPâti girls face one last threat, with a little help from a mysterious stranger.
